episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Once a rising actor, Hyeon-jun lived quietly until a student film made him a star. 7 years later, undercover reporter Jeong-sin drops into his world!

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: After a fiery red carpet clash, Jeong-sin is bumped to entertainment and exposes Hyeon-jun. Furious, he boots her from an event and she vows revenge!

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: As Hyeon-jun spirals, his mom Ae-suk shows up unannounced. Hwa-yeong spots the star at Jeong-sin's hospital and offers her a scool-for-transfer deal.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Jeong-sin sees a pitch on adult film actors and mentions Ae-suk, who she spotted in Hyeon-jun's hospital room. Her article drops, and chaos erupts!

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Hyeon-jun visits the stadium for his pitch, hoping Jeong-sin comes. She does and greets Jae-hyeong, sparking unexpected jealousy in Hyeon-jun.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Jeong-sin outs herself as a fan mid rice cooker deal. Hyeon-jun is moved by a stranger's confession. A hospital scoop kicks off their uneasy team-up.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Jeong-sin faces a lawsuit over Yoon Jung-ho's scandal. Hyeon-jun urges her to apologize, but the truth about Yoon reveals her real motive.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Jeong-sin confronts Hyeon-jun about Yoon Jung-ho, but hears a shocking plan. Meanwhile, Jae-hyeong asks her out, and she makes a bold choice.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Jeong-sin finally meets "Melomaster," but it's Byeong-gi posing as Hyeon-jun! Meanwhile, Hyeon-jun learns that "Soulishere" was Jeong-sin all along.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Jeong-sin crashes Hyeon-jun's shoot! Byeong-gi scrambles to hide his identity, while Hwa-yeong plots to bring Jeong-sin and Hyeon-jun together.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Hyeon-jun, Jeong-sin, Hwa-yeong and Jae-hyeong end up in a sudden four-way meet. Hearing Jeong-sin will attend the press event, Hyeon-jun acts fast.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Hyeon-jun finally confesses everything to Jeong-sin. It leaves her confused, until she takes the first step and asks to meet. What awaits them now?

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Hyeon-jun and Jeong-sin cross paths at King's Back. Meanwhile, tensions rise on set and Hyeon-jun storms off after clashing with Byeong-gi and Se-na.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: Hyeon-jun desperately reaches out to Jeong-sin after hearing Mr. Hwang's dismissal. Jeong-sin joins Hwang to secure evidence on the Lee Dae-ho case.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: Hyeon-jun's press conference statement stirs commotion, while Jeong-sin uncovers evidence of Lee Dae-ho's corruption, edging closer to the truth.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: Jeong-sin exposes Dae-ho's corruption to the world, but the backlash soon targets both her and Hyeon-jun. Now, they must pay the price of justice.
